title: Senior Full Stack Tech Lead
description: We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Tech Lead with 6+ years of experience to lead a team of 5 engineers. You must have deep expertise in React, Node.js, MongoDB, and REST API design. Experience with system design, microservices architecture, Docker, and AWS is required. You will be responsible for technical decision-making, code reviews, and mentoring junior developers.
responsibilities: Lead a team of 5 engineers across frontend and backend
Make key architectural and technology decisions
Design scalable system architecture for enterprise features
Conduct thorough code reviews and enforce best practices
Collaborate with product and design teams on feature planning
requirements: 6+ years of full stack development experience
Strong expertise in React, Node.js, MongoDB and Express
Experience in system design and microservices
Prior experience in a tech lead or senior engineer role
Excellent communication and team collaboration skills
